items.title: Mahalia Jackson Interview, 1955-07-26
items.q: Oh, L. Hines, Duke Ellington, Lionel Hamilton, all of them.

ctx.x: while ago that a number of musicians have, uh, wanted you to sing with their bands. Yeah. Armstrong,

for instance. Oh, L. Hines, Duke Ellington, Lionel Hamilton, all of them. You don't want to? No. No. You feel that it wouldn't be right? I do. I really do. Because, um, I feel like this, that no matter how wavered a person might be, they feel that there's a supreme being that is their superior. And they want to always be able to resort to that something as something to lift them up. And it's not this type of work that I do. It is not merely something for entertainment. It is an uplift. It is a reviving for…

Now, I understand so well what you mean. And, uh, I think it's wonderful that you will sing the songs you sing. And, uh, we hope to hear many, many more songs sung by you. We want to hear many more of your beautiful spirituals
